records.name: transport.foot.name
records.note: GDD 10: slowest, cheapest, and the most likely to trigger local stories.

records.name: transport.caravan.name
records.note: Safer but you must wait for one to form, or negotiate your way in.

records.name: transport.ship.name
records.note: Fast and high-capacity, but hostage to monsoon, storm and pirates.

records.name: transport.post.name
records.note: The Kaan's post road. Fastest overland, but requires the tablet of authority.

records.name: transport.pilgrim.name
records.note: Cheap and safe between religious centres; the route choice is not yours.

records.name: transport.embassy.name
records.note: Opens courts, costs freedom: you go where the mission goes.
